attachments.failed: Could not add: {names}. Check that the files and binder folder are available, then try again.

attachments.unreadable.other: {count} items are not readable local files.

binder.changedMessage: “{name}” was modified outside DayNote while you have unsaved edits. Reload from disk and lose your edits, or keep your version (the next save overwrites the file)?
binder.deleted: The binder file was deleted. Your edits remain; saving will recreate it.
binders.empty: No binders yet. Create or open one.
editor.empty: Select a note, or create one.
editor.readOnlyHint: This note is read-only — set its status to Draft or Ready to edit.
failure.attachmentPicker: The attachment picker could not be opened. Your note is unchanged; try adding attachments again.
failure.newBinderPicker: The new-binder picker could not be opened. Try creating the binder again.
failure.openBinder: This binder could not be opened. Check that it is available, then try again.
failure.openBinderFormat: This binder could not be opened because its contents are not valid DayNote data. Repair the binder or restore a known-good copy, then try again.
failure.openBinderGone: This binder is no longer available at the selected location.
failure.openBinderPermission: This binder could not be opened. Check that you have permission to read it, then try again.
failure.openBinderPicker: The binder picker could not be opened. Try opening the binder again.
failure.openExternalLink: The link could not be opened in your browser. Try again.
failure.reloadBinder: The binder changed on disk but could not be reloaded. Your version remains open; check the log and try again.
failure.saveBinder: Your changes are still in DayNote, but the binder could not be saved. Check that its location is available and has enough free space, then try again.
failure.saveBinderGone: Your changes are still in DayNote, but the binder location is no longer available. Restore the location, then try again.
failure.saveBinderPermission: Your changes are still in DayNote, but the binder could not be saved. Check that the binder location is writable, then try again.
failure.settingsSave: Settings could not be saved. Your changes are still here; try again.
failure.startupData: DayNote could not read its configuration or state files, so saving is disabled to avoid overwriting good data. Check the session log, repair or remove the affected data file, and restart.
failure.startupStorage: DayNote could not open its storage location. Check that the location exists and is writable, then restart DayNote.
note.attachmentsLeft: The note is gone, but its attachment files could not be deleted. They are still in the binder’s assets folder.
note.deleteAttachment: Its attachment is deleted with it.

note.deleteAttachments.one: Its {count} attachment is deleted with it.
note.deleteAttachments.other: Its {count} attachments are deleted with it.

notes.empty: No notes yet. Create one to get started.
notes.noBinder: Open or create a binder to add notes.
quarantine.binderListBody: A data file was unreadable, so DayNote preserved it rather than overwriting it. DayNote started with an empty binder list; your binder files are untouched, but the list of open binders and their custom titles is only in the preserved copy. Check the session log for its location, then re-open your binders or recover the list before quitting.
quarantine.settingsBody: A settings file was unreadable, so DayNote preserved it and started with defaults in its place. Your binders and notes are untouched. Check the session log for the preserved copy’s location.
settings.themeHint: With System, the theme follows the computer’s appearance.

settings.uiFontHint: Comma-separated; the first installed family is used. If left blank, the default (Inter) is used.
